title: Ukrainian Pasta Bake
description: A hearty and comforting Ukrainian-inspired pasta bake with rich flavors.

ingredients.name: ukrainian
ingredients.notes: such as Ukrainian-style cheese or sour cream

ingredients.name: bake
ingredients.notes: such as shredded mozzarella or cheddar

instructions: Cook the pasta according to package instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat the oil over medium-high heat. Add the onion and cook until translucent.
Add the garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Stir in the Ukrainian and cook for 1-2 minutes until heated through.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked pasta, Ukrainian mixture, and bake. Mix well to combine.
Transfer the pasta mixture to a baking dish and top with additional bake if desired.
Bake for 15-20 minutes until the top is golden brown and the casserole is heated through.
